answer: One mind wearing many masks still breathes through a single inference pipeline, so its masks answer in lockstep. The economy anchors each identity to a behavioral fingerprint, submit-latency, token cadence and shared funding edges, and when a cluster moves as one voyage it collapses them into a single payout seat. A fleet that tried to harbor a hundred sybils then earns like one agent, and every bonded deposit behind the collapsed masks is forfeit, so the attacker pays N stakes to buy one agent's income.
